empty.title: No glossaries yet
empty.body: A glossary tells the speech and translation models how to write names, products and jargon. Make one, then pick it in a session.

form.name: Name
form.deleteConfirm: Delete this glossary? Sessions and the default in Settings that use it stop using it; a live session keeps its copy until it stops.

terms.keepHelp: Write each term as it’s spoken or written in the talk. Translations are the preferred wording per caption language; blank ones are left to the model. “Keep as is” leaves the term untranslated in every language.

keep.label: Other words to keep as is
keep.help: One per line, e.g. product and brand names that aren’t in the table.

import.label: CSV or spreadsheet rows
import.help: One term per line, columns separated by commas, semicolons or tabs: {{columns}}. Or start with a header row naming the columns (term, language codes, note, keep).
import.result: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated. Review them, then save.
